decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is core shop-extension know-how the firm can maintain cheaply, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 and possible shop-platform version changes raise some risk of retirement.
The ERP interface draws on the firm's deep integration expertise and serves recurring multichannel client needs, so its own development capacity justifies continuing to refine it.

Price comparison tracking fits the firm's analytics knowledge, but portal-specific plugins are exposed to portal and platform changes, and the earlier pruning of a sibling plugin signals elevated risk.

As another portal-specific tracking plugin that overlaps with Product C and has not been visible since 2019, it adds little new learning, so its resources are better consolidated into the core analytics offer.
Net price reporting shares its knowledge base with the display plugin and complements it, so it is cheap to absorb and maintain, despite uncertainty from its absence on the website.
